levels.name: Infallible Procession
levels.description: Each time Dahlia gains 1 of his Elemental Burst Radiant Psalter's Benison stacks, he will regain 2.5 Elemental Energy.

levels.name: Revelation of Mercy
levels.description: After Dahlia consumes his Elemental Burst Radiant Psalter's Benison stacks to summon a Shield of Sacred Favor, the character protected by said Shield will gain 25% increased Shield Strength for 12s.

levels.name: Windblume Offertory
levels.description: Increases the Level of Radiant Psalter by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Collect of the Assembly
levels.description: The Favonian Favor from Dahlia's Elemental Burst Radiant Psalter lasts 3 more seconds.

levels.name: Let It Be Subtly So
levels.description: Increases the Level of Immersive Ordinance by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: You Shall Go Out With Joy
levels.description: The current active character affected by the Elemental Burst Radiant Psalter's Favonian Favor has their ATK SPD increased by 10%. Additionally, when an active character affected by Favonian Favor falls, immediately: Revive them. Restore their HP to 100%. This effect can trigger once every 15 minutes.
